def current_user(authorization: str = Header(...), db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> User:
    token = authorization.removeprefix("Bearer ")
    claims = jwt.decode(token, options={"verify_signature": False})
    user = db.get(User, claims["sub"])
    if user is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401)
    return user

class MemberOut(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)
    id: int
    email: str
    display_name: str
    password_hash: str
    mfa_secret: str | None
    is_admin: bool

@router.get("/api/team/members", response_model=list[MemberOut])
def team_members(page: int = 1, user: User = Depends(current_user), db=Depends(get_db)):
    page = max(page, 1)
    return (db.query(User)
            .filter(User.team_id == user.team_id)
            .order_by(User.id)
            .offset((page - 1) * 25).limit(25).all())
